name: Nanjou Asuka
source:
Former high school classmate of Takurou, and the school Madonna of sorts. Takurou confessed his feeling for her in the past only to be cruelly rejected.  On the surface, she is a friendly, kind, and a good-natured person, but behind the scenes she is calculating and self-centered. 

When she is alone with Takurou, she does not hide the fact that she finds Takurou disgusting. She does not care if he knows her true feelings towards him.

[Translated from [url=http://amatures.ohimesama.net/saimin/]Official site[/url]]
